## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**

DIVERGENCE: XLK RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%), VXX CORRECTION (1W: -1.46% | 1M: +6.02%) and pockets of 1W/1M mismatch (e.g., XLF 1M slightly negative) warrant monitoring for rotation risks.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor cyclical exposure (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%)) and EM risk via EEM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.43% | 1M: +7.00%); reduce exposure to speculative/volatile exposures where 1M weakness persists (IBIT RECOVERY (1W: +3.70% | 1M: -24.83%), ARKK RECOVERY (1W: +4.44% | 1M: -10.96%)). Keep bonds (TLT ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.20% | 1M: +2.80%)) as tactical ballast.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.27% | 1M: +11.41%) and TAN ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.12% | 1M: +14.39%). BEARISH: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -3.38% | 1M: -11.95%) and SLV RECOVERY (1W: +13.13% | 1M: -8.74%) for heightened volatility.

**13. Key Levels?**

Credit Spread 0.7259 (1W: +0.19% | 1M: -0.83%) and Stocks vs Bonds 7.7109 (1W: +1.48% | 1M: -2.23%) are critical for risk trajectory; Tech/Financials ratio 2.6839 (1W: -0.67% | 1M: -0.32%) signals where growth/value leadership may pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
RISK-ON. Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive. Energy and cyclicals showing strength (XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.67% | 1M: +12.57%), XLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.25% | 1M: +7.55%)). Key risk is rotation/divergence from Tech (XLK RECOVERY (1W: +1.20% | 1M: -2.04%)) and lingering credit stress signals to monitor.
